Vanessa / Team —

Confirming security steps.
1) Applied legal hold on buckets: logs-usw2-runtime-FS-4982, traces-usw2-FS-4982. Rotation disabled and retention set to infinite for these objects.
2) Creating sealed archive: we will create a read-only tarball inside our evidence staging S3 account (redwood-evidence-usw2). Each archive will be hashed (SHA256) and the hash entered into the manifest.

Estimated timelines: initial staging snapshot by 2028-04-05 15:00Z; manifest and signed hashes by 2028-04-06 EOD. Full raw extraction (if required) will need Legal approval and will take ~36 hours given size constraints.

I will post the staging link and manifest when ready.
